datasets.title: Nigeria - Roads
datasets.description: Abstract: The geodata represents roads network in Nigeria. Scale 1:1,000,000. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/nigeria-roads]
datasets.details: **Most Recent Changes:** The codification is updated by OCHA/ROWCA in Feb 2012. These data have been zipped with Winzip 11.1. Please, would use the same or more recent version of this software to unzip. **Dataset Language:** English.

lineage.description: Road network geometry was sourced from the Digital Chart of the World (DCW) and updated by OCHA/ROWCA in February 2012. The dataset represents the national road infrastructure of Nigeria at 1:1,000,000 scale in shapefile format, providing spatial inventory of transportation infrastructure for disaster risk assessment.
